Sweep wheel v2 — 12-sector hybrid

Press a sector — the ring reveals only that group's letters. Sweep to the letter, release commits; the centre previews the pick live. ⊗ commits · 🗑 discards · centre tap = backspace · top arc = abc / ABC / 123 / #$.
